limitations: Smoke tests, deterministic on/off comparisons and in-game shadow comparisons; not exhaustive gameplay, every option combination or long sessions.

Ported from Forge 1.0.36 as a delta on the published 1.0.35+mc1.21.1, with the MixinSquared cancellation check of Forge 1.0.38, and reconciled with both frozen Forge releases named in base (1.0.38 is 1.0.36 plus that check, with the same switches and defaults); its default values are the same.

The 1.0.36 switches were ported by comparing the 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 target code; their in-game checks here are that every guarded switch applies with its target installed, that shadow modes report no mismatch where the scenes reach them, and that the terrain stays identical. Their 1.20.1 measurements are not repeated on 1.21.1.
vanilla_mob_class_warmup: checked for correctness on 1.21.1; its effect on first-spawn lag spikes was measured on Forge 1.20.1 only.
distanthorizons_join_config_resend: on 1.21.1 its hook applies and leaves singleplayer alone; no run joined a dedicated server.

Shadow helpers with no work in any fixture (their mods are installed, but nothing in the scripted scenes reached the code): BakeLocations, CubeBakeMemo, CucumberTileDispatch, EmptyFilters, FramedMaps, RedPandaGate, SearchReplay, SortedConnections, SpawnerPresence, StructureRing.
Terrain on/off equality is proven on the base game, on the TerraBlender/BWG fixture without Dynamic Trees, and next to Generator Accelerator 1.6.2 and Bye Pregen 1.1.3.0.
The Collections Of Optimizations step-aside entries are kept; no build of that mod exists for 1.21.1 NeoForge to test them against.
Generator Accelerator 1.6.2 sometimes stops generating chunks by itself; its fixtures are the first runs that got through.
No performance benchmark or FPS gain is claimed for the port.
No publication, no managed instance installation, no managed world edits.
